name: led-hongli-2835-hr6-6500k
description: HONGLITRONIC HL-AM-2835H421W-S1-08-HR6 2835 white LED, 6500 K (6000-7000 K), Ra 95, SDCM<6, 60 mA, Vf 2.8-3.4 V (3.1 typ), 120 deg, ~22 lm (LCSC C516135)

vf_trim.description: forward-voltage offset in volts for this LED (bin/part spread); the series source V<ref>_trim also measures the LED current: probe i(V<ref>_trim)

cct.description: colour temperature (informational; must match the LCSC part)

spice.model:
* HONGLITRONIC HL-AM-2835H421W-S1-08-HR6 (Ra 95), 60 mA rated (IF max 90 mA at 25 C, derating to 45 mA at 85 C). JLCPCB lists Vf 3.4 V, which is the bin maximum; the Vf groups span 2.8-3.4 V.
* Fitted for 3.10 V at 60 mA (typical), tempco -2.0 mV/K; SPICE gives dVf/dT = (Vf_j - EG - XTI*Vt)/T so EG is a fitting value, not the bandgap. vf_trim=+0.30 is the worst bin.
.model HONGLI_HR6_65 D(IS=2.185e-21 N=2.6 RS=1.5 EG=3.559 XTI=2 CJO=50p TT=5n BV=8)

metadata.rotation_note: Footprint has the anode at -x and the cathode at +x. JLCPCB's reel zero-orientation for this part is not yet verified: check the polarity in their placement preview on the first order and record the correction here.
